hud.signInHint: Sign in through Steam to get your game key and save your times.

home.intro: Courses made by Beatrun players. Copy a code, open the courses menu in-game with {key} and load it. Finished runs go to the leaderboard.
home.title: Courses
home.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches the search or map.
home.emptyAll: Nobody has uploaded a course yet.

course.notFoundText: There is no course with code {code}. It may have been deleted.
course.codeCopied: Code copied, paste it in the courses menu
course.howTo: Load the map {map}, press {key}, paste the code and start the course.

tips.record: Fastest time anyone has finished this course in
tips.average: Average of every player's best time
tips.players: How many players have finished this course
tips.downloads: Downloads from the game and from this site
tips.checkpoints: Checkpoints you have to pass to finish
tips.elements: Props and entities placed on the course

course.leaderboardHint: Best time of everyone who finished this course.
course.noRunsText: Finish this course in-game with your key set and your time shows up here.
course.deleteText: {name} ({code}) and all times on it will be removed. This can't be undone.
course.fileHint: Put the file into {path} and it shows up in the local courses list (F4).

update.title: Update course file
update.text: Replace {name} ({code}) with a new version. The code and the link stay the same.
update.lostRecords: All {n} players' times on this course are deleted
update.lostRuns: The runs counter ({n}) is reset to zero
update.lostTimes: Record and average time are gone until people play again
update.lostPoints: Players lose the leaderboard points they had from this course
update.kept: Kept: code, author, upload date and downloads. The name and speed limit come from the new file.
update.fileHint: The file the game saved in garrysmod/data/beatrun/courses/<map>/
update.confirm: I understand that every time on this course will be deleted and can't be restored

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.scoring: Each course is worth up to 1000 points. The record holder gets all of them, everyone else gets {formula}.
leaderboard.creatorsScoring: Creators are ranked by how many times their courses were downloaded, then by how many courses they made.
leaderboard.emptyPlayersText: Finish any course in-game with your key set to show up here.

profile.notFoundText: This player has never signed in on this site.

stats.runsOnThem: {n} run on them | {n} runs on them

tips.rank: Place among all players by points
tips.points: Sum of points from every finished course, up to 1000 per course
tips.records: Courses where this player holds the fastest time
tips.completed: Different courses finished at least once

profile.noTimesOwn: Finish a course in-game with your key set and the time shows up here.
profile.noCoursesOwn: Build a course in-game and upload it from the courses menu ({key}).

key.title: Game key
key.text: Paste it into the courses menu in-game ({key}, Profile tab) to upload courses and save your times. Don't share it.
key.confirmText: Your current key stops working right away. You'll have to paste the new one into the game.
key.generated: New key generated, paste it into the game again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.text: Sign in through Steam to get your game key. With it you can upload courses from the game and your finished runs go to the leaderboard. Only your Steam ID, name and avatar are saved.

admin.subtitle: Manage users, courses and leaderboard times.
admin.title: Admin

tips.users: Everyone who has signed in on the site
tips.times: Best times saved, one per player and course
tips.runs: Every finished run on every course
tips.downloads: Course downloads from the game and the site
tips.userTimes: Courses the user has a time on

users.search: Search by name or Steam ID
users.deleteText: Their key stops working. They can sign in again later and get a new account.
users.purgeText: Removes {courses} (with all times on them) and their {times}.
users.banText: They won't be able to upload or update courses or submit times. The reason is shown to them on the site and in the game.

courses.editText: {code} · the course file itself is not changed.
courses.name: Name
courses.deleteText: Course {code} and all times on it will be removed. This can't be undone.

records.deleteText: {time} by {player} on {course}. Use this for cheated or broken runs.

ban.title: Your account is blocked
ban.text: Blocked on {date}. You can't upload or update courses and your times are not saved. You can still browse the site and delete your own courses.
